company_name: Beijing Gritek & IVT Technology Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company manufactures clean pipe valve products specifically for semiconductor applications.
summary: Beijing Gritek & IVT Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the production and sale of BA and EP grade clean pipe valve products for the semiconductor industry. Established in 2020, the company has expanded its operations with a subsidiary in Dezhou, Shandong, to enhance local technical support for its products.
capabilities: BA and EP grade clean pipe valves
Technical support services for semiconductor applications
Manufacturing of valve components from special materials

regional_presence.China: The company has established a wholly-owned subsidiary in Dezhou, Shandong, to better serve local customers.
